title: Delete your Orderz House account
intro: You can request deletion of your Orderz House account and associated personal data from inside the mobile app via:
inAppPath: My Account → Account settings → Delete account
fallbackIntro: If you can no longer access the app, you can request account deletion by email using the address below.
whatHappensTitle: What happens when an account is deleted?

bullets.deactivate: The account is deactivated and sign-in is blocked.
bullets.personalData: Unnecessary personal data such as phone number and profile photo is deleted or hidden when possible.
bullets.retention: We may retain some records related to orders, payments, disputes, invoices, or legal/operational requirements for security, fraud prevention, legal compliance, and accounting.
bullets.ordersPayments: Orders and payments are not deleted in a way that harms clients, freelancers, or financial records.

howToBody: Please email the address below, include the email address linked to your account, and write the phrase:
privacyAppendixBody: You can request deletion of your Orderz House account in the mobile app or via our public account-deletion page. Deletion deactivates the account and removes or hides unnecessary personal data where possible, while order, payment, and legally required records may be retained.
